parsed.explanation: The passage is indeed explicitly labeled “Conjecture,” and the write-up supplies only computational observations. It gives no all-terms argument proving that membership depends on finitely many primes (the large-prime-erasure lemma), nor any proof that admissible residue classes stabilize. The “Current best” section itself says these facts still “Need a rigorous proof,” and the “Full proof” is marked incomplete. Thus the essential finiteness obligation (F), and consequently the periodicity assembly (P), remain unproved.
